app_fee.value: Application fees for degree-seeking programs are currently waived for international applicants (unless a specific program notes otherwise on the application checklist; the special student fee schedule lists $40 domestic graduate and the Graduate Catalog mentions $150 international graduate fees).
app_fee.quote: Currently application fees for degree-seeking programs are waived for international applicants. If an application fee is required for your chosen program, it will appear on your checklist.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver request is needed because application fees for degree-seeking programs are currently waived for international applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: Currently application fees for degree-seeking programs are waived for international applicants.

gre_general.value: Graduate Admissions leaves standardized test requirements (GRE/GMAT) to individual academic programs; both STEM Ph.D. programs at Marshall state that GRE scores are not required but may be submitted to strengthen an application.

toefl_min.value: Minimum TOEFL iBT score is 4.5 or 86 for exams taken after January 20, 2026 (1/21/2026 or later in the Graduate Catalog), or 80 for exams taken before January 21, 2026 (ETS institution code 5396).
toefl_min.quote: TOEFL iBT (Exam taken before 1/21/2026) | 61 | 80 | TOEFL iBT (Exam taken after 1/20/2026) | 4.0 or 72 | 4.5 or 86

ielts_min.value: Minimum IELTS (Academic) score is 6.5 (Duolingo 105, PTE Academic/Express 60 on International Admissions or PTE 53 in the Graduate Catalog, and MELAB 82% are also accepted).

english_waiver.value: India is not on Marshall's Approved List of Countries for Direct Entry English Proficiency Exemption; Indian applicants must submit English proficiency scores unless they have completed 18 graduate credit hours (one year full-time study) or a degree at a U.S.-accredited institution or an approved ESL program.
english_waiver.quote: The proof of English proficiency requirement may be waived if we receive official proof of the equivalent of a U.S. high school diploma or U.S. post-secondary degree from an accepted, accredited institution in one of the approved English-speaking countries listed below. ... Asia | Singapore

notes: Located in Huntington, WV (Carnegie R2). International graduate applicants must submit a NACES or AICE course-by-course credential evaluation with CGPA. Only two Ph.D. degrees are offered university-wide: Biomedical Research, Ph.D. (Joan C. Edwards School of Medicine, including the Neurobiology and Addiction cluster) and Engineering, Ph.D. (College of Engineering and Computer Sciences). Excluded non-Atlas Engineering Ph.D. concentrations: Cyber Security, Engineering Management, and Industrial and System Engineering.
